36.0.en: At last they [[harvest:harvest]] together and [[pluck:pluck]] only what the cooks need.
36.0.zh: 终于到了收获的时候，大家动手，只摘厨师需要的量。

36.1.en: Each box gives a fair [[yield:yield]], and they [[rear:rear]] worms in one corner.
36.1.zh: 每个箱子都有不错的产量，他们还在一角养蚯蚓。

36.2.en: No [[arable:arable]] land exists here, so they [[plough:plough]] the tubs with forks.
36.2.zh: 这里没有可耕地，他们就用叉子翻松大盆里的土。

36.3.en: Leo holds the small [[spade:spade]] while Sam pulls the light [[rake:rake]] steadily.
36.3.zh: 利奥握着小铲，萨姆稳稳地拉着轻耙。

36.4.en: They [[stack:stack]] the washed pots neatly and turn a rich compost [[heap:heap]] daily.
36.4.zh: 他们把洗净的盆整齐摞好，每天翻动肥沃的堆肥堆。

36.5.en: Mia ties a neat [[bundle:bundle]] of sticks and a fresh [[bunch:bunch]] of flowers for the neighbours.
36.5.zh: 米娅把枝条捆成整齐的一束，又扎了一捧鲜花送给邻居。

37.0.en: The best cuts fill a blue [[vase:vase]] that catches the morning [[sunlight:sunlight]] softly.
37.0.zh: 最好的剪枝插满蓝花瓶，柔柔地接住晨光。

37.1.en: [[short day:Short day]] greens and [[shade-tolerant:shade-tolerant]] ferns share the cool north corner.
37.1.zh: 短日照青菜和耐阴的蕨类，共享阴凉的北角。

37.2.en: They scrubbed one [[fungus:fungus]] spot and wiped grey [[mould:mould]] from the dish edge.
37.2.zh: 他们刷掉一处真菌斑，擦去盘边的灰霉。

37.3.en: Yellow [[pollen:pollen]] covered the table where new beans [[germinate:germinate]] in moss.
37.3.zh: 黄黄的花粉落在桌上，新豆子正在苔藓里发芽。

37.4.en: Each saved [[seed:seed]] seems to [[burgeon:burgeon]] after three warm [[spring:spring]] mornings.
37.4.zh: 每粒留存的种子，似乎在三个温暖的春晨之后就开始抽芽。

37.5.en: Every firm [[bud:bud]] may open into a pink [[blossom:blossom]] by Friday.
37.5.zh: 每个紧实的蓓蕾，到周五都可能开成粉色的花朵。

38.0.en: Each fresh [[bloom:bloom]] adds a sweet [[scent:scent]] to their evening talks.
38.0.zh: 每朵新开的花，都给他们的傍晚闲谈添一缕甜香。

38.1.en: The small [[aromatic:aromatic]] leaves [[ripen:ripen]] slowly beside the warm glass wall.
38.1.zh: 芳香的小叶在温暖的玻璃墙边慢慢长熟。

38.2.en: They pick each red [[fruit:fruit]] before hot winds make the petals [[wither:wither]].
38.2.zh: 他们赶在热风吹蔫花瓣之前，摘下每颗红果实。

38.3.en: Fallen bits [[decompose:decompose]] fast, or wet stems [[rot:rot]] in the corner.
38.3.zh: 落下的碎屑很快分解，不然湿茎就会在角落里腐烂。

38.4.en: They clear away the slow [[decay:decay]] of old leaves and hand [[stale:stale]] crumbs to the birds.
38.4.zh: 他们清走慢慢腐烂的旧叶，把不新鲜的碎屑喂给小鸟。

38.5.en: Their corner display mimics a wet [[rainforest:rainforest]] and looks like a tiny [[jungle:jungle]].
38.5.zh: 他们那一角的布置模仿潮湿的雨林，看上去像一小片丛林。

39.0.en: Photos of a tea [[plantation:plantation]] and a windy barley [[field:field]] move them.
39.0.zh: 茶园和风中大麦田的照片打动了他们。

39.1.en: Old [[timber:timber]] crates and a small [[charcoal:charcoal]] doodle brighten their work wall.
39.1.zh: 旧木箱和一幅小小的炭笔涂鸦，把工作墙点缀得亮了起来。

39.2.en: A [[forestry:forestry]] poster shows how to prune one crowded [[branch:branch]] safely.
39.2.zh: 一张林业海报展示如何安全修剪挤作一团的枝条。

39.3.en: They painted a thick [[trunk:trunk]] with one stout [[bough:bough]] for climbing cats.
39.3.zh: 他们画了一根粗树干和一条结实的大枝，专供猫儿攀爬。

39.4.en: A [[shallow:shallow]] [[root:root]] mass rests under a thin [[hay:hay]] cover till morning.
39.4.zh: 浅浅的根团盖着薄薄一层干草，一直捂到天亮。

39.5.en: They spread dry [[straw:straw]] around the shoots and tie one tall [[reed:reed]] upright.
39.5.zh: 他们在嫩苗四周铺上干稻草，把一株高高的芦苇绑直。

40.0.en: Leo pulls out each sharp [[thorn:thorn]] stalk and every spreading [[weed:weed]] early.
40.0.zh: 利奥一大早就拔掉每根带尖刺的茎和每株蔓延的杂草。

40.1.en: Fresh [[grass:grass]] clippings bring back memories of a wide [[meadow:meadow]] walk last June.
40.1.zh: 刚剪下的草屑，让他想起去年六月走过大片草地的散步。

40.2.en: They clip the tiny [[lawn:lawn]] edge near a young [[olive:olive]] sapling.
40.2.zh: 他们修剪小草坪的边缘，旁边是一株年轻的橄榄苗。

40.3.en: A bonsai [[pine:pine]] stands cool beside a curling [[vine:vine]] trellis.
40.3.zh: 一盆盆景松静静立在缠绕着藤蔓的架子旁。

40.4.en: One [[violet:violet]] tag marks the Dutch [[tulip:tulip]] row by date.
40.4.zh: 一张紫罗兰色的标签，按日期标出荷兰郁金香那一畦。

40.5.en: Crushed [[mint:mint]] smells fresh while the coral [[reef:reef]] book lies open.
40.5.zh: 压碎的薄荷清香扑鼻，珊瑚礁的书还摊在一旁。

41.0.en: A green [[alga:alga]] coats the beaker where a busy [[enzyme:enzyme]] breaks waste down.
41.0.zh: 一层绿藻附着在烧杯内壁，杯里有一种忙碌的酶在分解废物。

41.1.en: Warmth acts as a [[catalyst:catalyst]] and helps shoots [[release:release]] their firm covers.
41.1.zh: 温暖充当催化剂，帮嫩芽挣脱紧裹的外皮。

41.2.en: They log scooter [[emission:emission]] outdoors and let broad leaves [[absorb:absorb]] moisture.
41.2.zh: 他们在户外记录机车的排放，让宽大的叶子吸收湿气。

41.3.en: Good air [[circulation:circulation]] matters, and pots must never [[exceed:exceed]] two sprouts.
41.3.zh: 空气流通很重要，每盆绝不能超过两株苗。

41.4.en: Slow [[uptake:uptake]] of each [[nutrient:nutrient]] keeps the young stems firm.
41.4.zh: 每种养分都被缓慢吸收，嫩茎因而长得结实。

41.5.en: Keeping clean [[surroundings:surroundings]] each week supports each [[natural:natural]] defence [[mechanism:mechanism]] beneath the soil.
41.5.zh: 每周保持环境整洁，能帮助土壤之下每一道天然的防御机制。

42.0.en: New shade nets [[counterbalance:counterbalance]] the harsh light and [[protect:protect]] young shoots at noon.
42.0.zh: 新遮阳网抵消强光，在正午保护幼小的苗。

42.1.en: Fallen petals are [[preserve:preserved]] for art, and the class learns the rules of [[conservation:conservation]] together.
42.1.zh: 落花被保存下来做手工，全班还一起学习保护自然的规矩。

42.2.en: The class learned how crews stop a [[bush fire:bush fire]] and [[extinguish:extinguish]] stray sparks.
42.2.zh: 全班学习了消防员如何拦住灌木火灾、熄灭四散的火星。

42.3.en: They spoke against the [[destruction:destruction]] that litter causes, because it could [[ruin:ruin]] nests along the river.
42.3.zh: 他们反对乱扔垃圾造成的破坏，因为那会毁掉河边的鸟巢。

42.4.en: Weak shoots [[perish:perish]] fast if builders [[demolish:demolish]] the old side wall.
42.4.zh: 如果工人拆掉旧侧墙，柔弱的幼苗很快就会死掉。

42.5.en: They never [[infringe:infringe]] park rules or [[undermine:undermine]] shared beds with chemicals.
42.5.zh: 他们从不违反公园的规定，也从不用化学品损害共用的菜畦。

43.0.en: They read about bee [[extinction:extinction]] and map each visiting [[pattern:pattern]] carefully.
43.0.zh: 他们读到蜜蜂灭绝的故事，仔细画下每次到访的规律。

43.1.en: Every small [[outcome:outcome]] counts, and kind acts create a real [[impact:impact]].
43.1.zh: 每个小成果都算数，善行会带来真正的影响。

43.2.en: Their wall chart mixes [[seasonal:seasonal]] tasks with one small [[experimental:experimental]] corner.
43.2.zh: 他们的墙贴表把季节性任务和一小块试验角排在一起。

43.3.en: Warm [[spring:spring]] gives [[favourable:favourable]] light for long [[productive:productive]] afternoons together.
43.3.zh: 温暖的春光正合适，大家一起度过漫长而多产的午后。

43.4.en: A simple rota proves [[effective:effective]] and keeps their watering [[efficient:efficient]] daily.
43.4.zh: 简单的轮值表很有效，让每天的浇水都高效有序。

43.5.en: They feel [[considerable:considerable]] pride, though the plot is not [[massive:massive]] yet.
43.5.zh: 他们感到相当自豪，尽管这块小菜地还不算大。

44.0.en: The [[night:night]] sky gives [[immense:immense]] calm, and the number of stars above town is [[maximal:maximal]].
44.0.zh: 夜空带来无边的宁静，小镇上空的星星多到了极点。

44.1.en: With [[minimal:minimal]] noise and [[optimal:optimal]] darkness, Leo ends the happy evening.
44.1.zh: 噪音最小、黑暗正好，利奥结束了这个快乐的夜晚。

45.0.en: On Saturday morning Leo joined a kind [[zoologist:zoologist]] and a friendly [[ecologist:ecologist]] at the gate.
45.0.zh: 周六早晨，里奥在大门口见到了一位和善的动物学家和一位友好的生态学家。

45.1.en: A cheerful [[botanist:botanist]] showed them a soft baby [[mammal:mammal]] sleeping in warm [[straw:straw]].
45.1.zh: 一位开朗的植物学家给他们看了一只睡在暖干草里的柔软哺乳动物宝宝。

45.2.en: They watched a playful [[primate:primate]] swing while learning about each strong [[vertebrate:vertebrate]] in care.
45.2.zh: 他们看着一只爱玩的灵长类动物荡来荡去，同时了解每种正在接受照料的强壮脊椎动物。

45.3.en: Next they cleaned a slow [[reptile:reptile]] enclosure and a small green [[amphibian:amphibian]] pool nearby.
45.3.zh: 接着他们清洗了行动缓慢的爬行动物饲养箱，还有旁边小小的绿色两栖动物水池。

45.4.en: Leo learned that a meat-eating [[carnivore:carnivore]] needs different meals from a [[grass:grass]]-eating [[herbivore:herbivore]].
45.4.zh: 里奥了解到，食肉动物和吃草的食草动物需要的食物很不一样。

45.5.en: Every little [[creature:creature]] at the station deserves [[quiet:quiet]] care and daily support from the [[wildlife:wildlife]] team.
45.5.zh: 救助站里的每个小生灵，都值得安静的照料和野生动物保护队每天的支持。

46.0.en: They mapped [[local:local]] [[fauna:fauna]] with pictures and noted the tall [[flora:flora]] around the lake.
46.0.zh: 他们用图片记录当地的动物群，并记下湖边高大的植物群。

46.1.en: Each rescued [[species:species]] was listed, and a happy [[flock:flock]] of ducks passed overhead.
46.1.zh: 每个获救的物种都被登记在册，一群快乐的鸭子从头顶飞过。

46.2.en: Leo spotted a calm [[herd:herd]] of deer drinking while a busy [[swarm:swarm]] of bees moved past.
46.2.zh: 里奥望见安静的鹿群在喝水，一群忙碌的蜜蜂从旁飞过。

46.3.en: A noisy [[throng:throng]] of visitors arrived, but a bigger weekend [[crowd:crowd]] came after lunch.
46.3.zh: 一群吵闹的参观者到了，午后来的是更大的周末人群。

46.4.en: A large tired [[beast:beast]] rested quietly, and even a [[rough:rough]] [[brute:brute]] of a dog looked calm today.
46.4.zh: 一只又大又累的野兽安静地歇着，就连那只粗野的大狗今天也显得平静。

46.5.en: Nobody here is allowed to be [[cruel:cruel]], because kindness must [[originate:originate]] in every young heart.
46.5.zh: 这里不允许任何人残忍，因为善良必须从每颗年轻的心里生出来。

47.0.en: They [[derive:derive]] pleasure from small tasks that [[stem:stem]] from love for living things.
47.0.zh: 他们从源于热爱生命的小事中获得快乐。

47.1.en: An old photo showed an [[ancestor:ancestor]] of the gibbon with its happy [[descendant:descendant]] beside it.
47.1.zh: 老照片里，长臂猿的祖先和它快乐的后代并排站着。

47.2.en: The mother nursed her tiny [[offspring:offspring]] while a separate [[subgroup:subgroup]] played in the [[grass:grass]].
47.2.zh: 母亲哺育着小小的幼崽，另一小群则在草地上玩耍。

47.3.en: Volunteers [[feed:fed]] the young birds and learned how experts [[breed:breed]] rare ducks safely.
47.3.zh: 志愿者给幼鸟喂食，并学习专家如何安全地繁殖稀有鸭子。

47.4.en: They never let close families [[interbreed:interbreed]] and never [[hybridise:hybridise]] free ducks with farm ones.
47.4.zh: 他们从不让近亲之间交配，也从不把散养的鸭子和家鸭杂交。

47.5.en: Rabbits could [[proliferate:proliferate]] fast, so the vets watch their health closely, since poor health can lead to [[sterility:sterility]].
47.5.zh: 兔子可能繁殖得很快，所以兽医密切留意它们的健康，因为身体一差就可能导致不育。
